verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence touching this story is that in-progress tasks run in a live, shareable browser preview where teammates can 'hop in, watch it build, and weigh in.' That gives a thin browser-side way to observe and possibly redirect a running agent. Running agents locally via Claude or Codex is a choice of where to launch work, not a takeover of a cloud task already in progress. missing for 10: documented handoff of an in-progress agent task into a local editor or terminal, explicit ability to take control and finish the work yourself, detail on how 'weighing in' redirects the agent, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can take over an in-progress agent task in my editor, terminal, or browser to finish or redirect the work

citations.quote: Anyone on the team can hop in, watch it build, and weigh in. No local setup needed.
Open a live preview for any task in progress without affecting production.
